name: Atlas's Hoard
purpose: A local workspace for research cases: sources with graded reliability, entities and evidence-backed relations, a timeline, a map and competing-hypotheses analysis, for assistants over MCP.
notes: Keep the app running (python -m atlas_hoard): the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server, never opens the database, and starts the app itself when it is not answering. Tools that change or delete something: case_create, case_update, source_add, source_retract, entity_upsert, entity_merge, relation_add, relation_update, relation_retract, hypothesis_add, ach_rate, enrich, enrichment_undo; deletes need action=delete and confirm=true and only when the user asks. Enrichers never run on private persons; URL capture refuses social networks.
